Kennedy Jr. adds that the executive order will remove legal blocks for researchers and coordinate with the DEA and DOJ. Joe Rogan explains that these drugs were made illegal by the 1970 Controlled Substances Act under the Nixon administration and praises Trump for freeing people from those restrictions. Other speakers thank Trump for helping veterans and declare that he has "delivered an epic victory for all humanity."
